name: t4a-infra
description: Infrastructure-as-code for Time 4 Action — single source of truth for infra config.

scripts.auth0:export:prod: dotenvx run -f auth0/.env.prod -- a0deploy export --format yaml --output_folder auth0/tenant
scripts.auth0:export:dev: dotenvx run -f auth0/.env.dev -- a0deploy export --format yaml --output_folder auth0/tenant
scripts.auth0:import:dev: dotenvx run -f auth0/.env.dev -- a0deploy import --input_file auth0/tenant/tenant.yaml
scripts.auth0:import:prod: dotenvx run -f auth0/.env.prod -- a0deploy import --input_file auth0/tenant/tenant.yaml
scripts.mongo:sync:prod-to-dev: dotenvx run -f mongo/.env -- powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File mongo/scripts/sync-prod-to-dev.ps1
